profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Web Developer Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Web Developer with 20+ years of experience in building scalable applications. Specializing in PHP (Laravel, Symfony, WP) and JavaScript (Vue, React, Alpine, Node), with expertise in CRM systems, automation, and performance optimization. Proven track record in saving costs, increasing traffic, and improving workflow efficiencies. Open to remote or relocation opportunities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: At Agolix, an online assessment generator, I have upgraded the software from Vue 2 to Vue 3, improved performance, implemented various new features, and completely overhauled their PDF report builder.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · Laravel · JavaScript · PHP · DevOps

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Supported a booking platform for fishing trips. I spearheaded a deep integration with HubSpot Later, I developed an Admin Panel/CRM to replaced HubSpot, saving costs and bringing all communications in-house. Additionally, I created productivity tools, including an algorithm that automated trip replacements, achieving a 95% success rate which recovered potential lost revenue. I also helped transition the codebase into the TALL stack and implemented a brand redesign.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Laravel · Tailwind CSS · Livewire · MySQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed Givemethevin.com from end to end. Created a lead generating website that uses an algorithm and various APIs to calculate pricing and transportation costs. Customized an open source CRM to support a call center including SMS and phone integration. Automated report generation which fed back into the algorithm.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · Laravel · Vue.js · MySQL · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · REST APIs · DevOps

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained hundreds of websites for the auto dealer industry across the country, including inventory management and CRM systems. Designed and developed a custom framework for rapid website creation. Integrated with various third parties via SOAP and REST APIs.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · JavaScript · MySQL · Customer Relationship Management (CRM) · Inventory Management · REST APIs

positions.title: Web Designer/Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed PHP and Flash based websites for clients across multiple industries including eCommerce. Managed projects, schedules, scopes and client interaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Design · Web Development · JavaScript · PHP · MySQL · Adobe Creative Suite

positions.title: Interface Design Intern
positions.description: Designed media player skins in Photoshop and implemented them using JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Web Design · HTML · CSS · Adobe Photoshop
